description: The file 'convert.c' is a C source file implementing file format conversions, line ending conversions, encoding checks, and external filter applications within a version control system (likely Git). It handles text/binary detection, encoding validation, CRLF/LF conversions, and interfacing with external filters for complex conversions.

classes.name: struct text_stat
classes.description: A structure used for accumulating statistics about text content, including counts of NUL, CR, LF, CRLF, printable, and nonprintable characters.

classes.name: struct filter_params
classes.description: Holds parameters for filtering operations such as source buffer, file descriptor, command, and path.

classes.name: struct cmd2process
classes.description: Represents a subprocess for external filtering commands, with support for capabilities detection and command management.

classes.name: struct convert_driver
classes.description: Defines an external conversion driver with optional smudge, clean, process commands, and requirements.

classes.name: struct conv_attrs
classes.description: Holds characteristics and attributes of file conversion settings, such as CRLF handling, encoding, and associated driver.

classes.name: struct checkout_metadata
classes.description: Holds metadata for checkouts, including refname, treeish object ID, and blob ID.
